Constraint: the total distance of a week may be at most 10 percent higher than the total distance of the week before it. Week 1 has no earlier week to compare with. A decrease, no change, or an increase of exactly 10 percent satisfies the constraint. Only an increase of more than 10 percent violates it. The plan violates the constraint if at least one week violates it.
Verdict: satisfied
Comments: Week 1 has no previous week. Week 2 increases by 7.47%, Week 3 decreases, Week 4 decreases, and Week 5 decreases. Since no week increases by more than 10%, the plan satisfies the constraint.
